localization_method.selection: 11 merged fix PRs touching product code under src/, spread over July to October 2026 (#65, #164, #165, #198, #219, #358, #377, #405, #414, #422, #435), plus the L08 capability-limit case.
localization_method.cutoff: the first parent of each fix's merge commit; its committer time is the case cutoff
localization_method.gold: one requirement per changed src/ Python file, met by any enclosing function, method or class of a changed line in the cutoff tree (AST over the old side of the diff). Only a module-level change gives a path requirement.
localization_method.queries: symptom statements written from each PR's description; no query names a file, function, class or event identifier
localization_method.split: chronological 4/4/4 by cutoff; L08 falls between L07 and L09

event_vocabulary.memory.committed: host durable commit of an accepted item (append confirmed by WAITAOF)
event_vocabulary.memory.notice.remembered: host notice card after an fsync-confirmed commit
event_vocabulary.memory.notice.unconfirmed: host notice that a write is unconfirmed and can be retried
event_vocabulary.memory.notice.backlogged: an undelivered notice held for the next update or /memory
event_vocabulary.memory.served: an accepted item was served into context
event_vocabulary.memory.conflict.off: an agent-origin item conflicting with a user constraint went off without prompting
event_vocabulary.memory.prompt_user: the user was prompted about a conflict
event_vocabulary.memory.superseded: a newer user statement superseded an older one, keeping history
event_vocabulary.memory.withdrawn: an item was withdrawn (/forget or retraction)
event_vocabulary.memory.reverify: an anchored item needs a current applicability check
event_vocabulary.memory.switched_on: a user switch-on re-extracted the exact source
event_vocabulary.memory.switch_on_unavailable: switch-on refused because the source is no longer available
event_vocabulary.memory.archived_overflow: off metadata beyond the cap was archived unserved
event_vocabulary.memory.expired: an item expired (never allowed for accepted memory)
event_vocabulary.memory.trust_promoted: origin or trust was raised by repetition, usage, tests or a type tag
event_vocabulary.memory.import.optional: imported notes were admitted as optional context only
event_vocabulary.memory.extracted_from_summary: memory was extracted from a compaction summary
event_vocabulary.memory.secret_refused: a candidate was refused by the secret policy
event_vocabulary.memory.secret_refused_pin: # pragma: allowlist secret - an event name, not a secret
event_vocabulary.memory.pointer_only: only a pointer and hash were persisted (B1)
event_vocabulary.memory.body_persisted: a source body was persisted (B1 violation)
event_vocabulary.memory.blocked_untrusted_workspace: memory mutation refused in an untrusted workspace
event_vocabulary.brief.shown.first_response: the continuity brief was shown with the first response after a 7-day break
event_vocabulary.checkpoint.written: a turn-settlement continuation checkpoint was written
event_vocabulary.continuation.resumed: a session resumed from its checkpoint
event_vocabulary.continuation.baseline_rewritten: the checkpoint's baseline was reported missing or rewritten
event_vocabulary.restore.rekey_mapped: restore re-keyed projects through an explicit validated mapping
event_vocabulary.restore.rekey_unmapped: restore re-keyed without a validated mapping
event_vocabulary.restore.tombstones_applied: restore applied tombstones under the mapped scope
event_vocabulary.restore.mapping_rejected: an ambiguous or colliding mapping was rejected before publication
event_vocabulary.restore.held_unserved: restored memory held out of serving (deletion continuity unknown)
event_vocabulary.restore.published: restored memory was published for serving
event_vocabulary.recovery.phrase_used: recovery used the saved recovery phrase
event_vocabulary.secret.phrase_emitted: a recovery phrase reached ACP, a model, a tool result or diagnostics
event_vocabulary.export.sync_warning: the export target is a known sync root; opt-in required before the first write
event_vocabulary.rotation.committed: the new key generation pointer was committed
event_vocabulary.generation.old_rejected: old generations were rejected with current credentials
event_vocabulary.rotation.resumed_or_aborted: an interrupted rotation resumed or aborted with the old root usable
event_vocabulary.rotation.cleanup_resumed: old-root cleanup resumed idempotently after a crash
event_vocabulary.rotation.purge_deferred_to_next: a purge after the cutover watermark was deferred to the next rotation
event_vocabulary.rotation.manifest_amended: an acknowledged rotation manifest was amended

metrics.retrieval: recall and precision at a predeclared k=5 over the evidence each requirement accepts
metrics.answer: required-fact coverage; correctness as no prohibited claim; abstention correctness
metrics.citations: deterministic: every memory supporting the answer is cited at its served id and version; no fabricated citation
metrics.authority: count of lifecycle and authority violations (prohibited events, wrong memory state, cross-project serving)
metrics.completion: task completion as pre-registered per arm
metrics.latency: p50 and p95 timing over traces that record it
metrics.cost: fully loaded known cost with completeness; unknown stays unknown
metrics.localization_validity: independent tests or reviewed supporting evidence; a matching filename alone is not proof the candidate localized the cause

run_protocol.status: frozen design; nothing runs in this plan

arms.D: one pinned open generic harness (selected in Task 3) running Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and GPT 6.1 Sol, without Optimus assembly, memory or Auto
arms.D0: the Sonnet 5.5 Optimus-everything-off diagnostic per v12 section 12.5
arms.E: generic vendor arms, diagnostic and optional

run_protocol.labelling: arms with differing tool sets are labelled as such in every result

before_any_later_run: task completion definition per case kind
tools, effort and stopping rules per arm (Task 3 pins arm D's)
all-overhead cost allocation, including failed extraction, retries, maintenance and indexing
acceptance margins, approved by the operator
pre_registration.reporting: quality is reported separately from token repricing; savings stay labelled estimated (same tokens, repriced) or measured (matched runs)
pre_registration.judging: secondary judging is human-calibrated; disagreements are kept; judge uncertainty is INCONCLUSIVE
pre_registration.held_out: held-out size and acceptance thresholds are approved after the pilot and before acceptance runs; this seed set does not prove non-inferiority

limits: All gold is readable in the repository, including by the implementing agent; the #248 campaign needs a fresh sealed held-out set (Task 0 manifest).
M07 short-paste classification is best-effort; a miss is a measured residual, not a contract change.
Fixtures do not verify keystore, persistence, crash or backend deletion behaviour; M3 executes K5-R1/R2.
Every runtime K1-K6, model and harness result is UNRUN.

Cross-split locus overlap: L03 (train) shares client_catalog.py, client_disposition.py and ClientMcpSessionService with L07 (development), and spec.py with L06 (development). They are different fixes, so the same-issue rule holds, but a train case shows where MCP fixes land.
The fixture builders live in the review kit, so the seed set is rebuilt from there, not from this repository; the hashes above pin them.
